services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Ahoy! Are you ready for a waterfront adventure? Picture checking into a floating cottage on Barnegat Bay just before sunset. Your “BayCation” begins as you step aboard a modern houseboat docked along the bay near Long Beach Island, where the water becomes your front yard and the skyline glows gold at dusk. Each Boatyard Houseboat features accommodations for 4-6 guests. Each of our Houseboats is equipped with all the essentials to make your stay comfortable. From the fully outfitted kitchen to the cozy sleeping quarters, you’ll feel right at home while floating on the bay. There’s nothing quite like the view from our Houseboats.
